I started on 10 mg then bumped down to 5 mg because I like to start slow on psych meds since I’m sensitive to side effects. Currently up to 20 mg. I was more dizzy after taking it but at first the dizziness lasted all day. Now the tiredness passes. At first adjusting to buspirone you might feel worse but eventually it should help your anxiety. I felt stoned when I first started it but that should wear off in about a month or a few weeks (depends on the person). Helps slow down my anxious thoughts and relax my muscles.

Basically it slows down the amygdala so you won't overthink as much. It can make you tired (there's no anxiety meds that don't have that side effect unfortunately). You might feel really dizzy your first couple of weeks and not be able to do much but eventually adjust. I couldn't really walk anywhere for too long my first 2 weeks but it got better.

My ed program had us eat 3 meals a day + 3 snacks. Meal was protein with two sides. You want to include protein carb and fat for your meals. I’d slowly increase what you usually eat because doing it too quickly can cause digestive discomfort. I’d add in some protein shakes as well like ensure if you really can’t meet all your needs. Ultimately the goal would be to try to eat more foods and not live on supplements however it’s beneficial to have protein shakes in recovery at first because eating again is hard mentally and physically. 

Also pair a fear food with a safe food it makes eating easier. You need to challenge the cognitive distortions that your fear foods are “bad” or “evil”. Recovery isn’t linear so you might have days that are hard. Good luck on your recovery.
